prodDesc: This is our most popoular flavor. Has a sweet and buttery taste with a light and moist texture, that's perfect for any occasion.
This is our second most popular flavor. Has a strong cocoa and nutty taste with a fluffy and velvety texture, great for all chocolate lovers.
A smooth bed of custard cream to go in between cake layers, your choice of flavor.
A thick sweet fruit spread filling to go in between cake layers, your choice of fruit.
Want a cake that sparkles just like your ocassion? Choose our Glitter Cake, with equal parts shine and tasty-ness (has edible glitter).
